name: Refractories for Iron and Steel Plants

units.title: Introduction to Iron and Steel Making Processes
topics: 1.1. Overview of iron and steel production routes – Blast Furnace, Corex, Finex, and DRI process.
1.2. Flow diagram of iron and steel making with refractory application points.
1.3. Importance and selection of refractories for high-temperature zones.

units.title: Refractories for Iron Making – Blast Furnace
topics: 2.1. Construction and operation of blast furnace.
2.2. Refractories used in hearth (carbon), bosh & belly (alumina/SiC), and stack (alumina/graphite).
2.3. Refractory wear, gunning, patching, and maintenance practices. 09 20%

units.title: Hot Metal Handling and Primary Steel Making
topics: 3.1. Hot metal transfer ladles, runners, torpedoes – construction and refractory types.
3.2. LD Converter – process, refractory lining (MgO-C), slag splashing, and laser thickness measurement.
3.3. Desulphurisation process and refractory used in lances. 08 10%

units.title: Secondary Steel Making and Casting Refractories
topics: 4.1. Steel ladle – design, refractories used, life analysis, slide gate and purging plug.
4.2. RH Degasser and vacuum vessel refractories.
4.3. Continuous casting platform refractories – tundish, shroud, SEN, and maintenance

units.title: Total Refractory Management (TRM) and Safety
topics: 5.1. Concept of TRM, importance, and scope in steel industries.
5.2. Common safety precautions during refractory erection and maintenance.
